fusions.name: Flung Clod
fusions.desc: Kicks back a clod that deals 8 damage, up to 1.5 times as much at its full reach of 6 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Enervated] for 6 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Trampling Circuit
fusions.desc: Tramples a slow circle, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Your afflictions on each spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Long Ride Home
fusions.desc: Increases your stamina recovery by 50% for 25 seconds.

fusions.name: Hoofsore Rest
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you gain a shield of 20% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
